videos.title: Using Agents for Long-Horizon Financial Work — Aman Singh, Arca
videos.description:
Arca head of AI Aman Singh joins Latent Space head of editorial Richard MacManus at AI Engineer New York, to discuss how Arca is building an AI-native wealth management firm. 

Singh explains Arca's architecture, which includes a custom harness and persistent memory. He also digs into how Arca runs agentic workflows that span days, not hours.

videos.name: Latent Space
videos.title: Building ChatGPT for Finance — Joseph Kim, OpenAI's Head of Financial Services
videos.description:
What does it take to build AI for finance on top of a general-purpose model?

Joseph Kim, who leads work on ChatGPT for Financial Services at OpenAI, joins swyx and Richard at AI Engineer New York to discuss the decisions behind the product: training financial reasoning into a shared model, connecting market data, and building workflows financial professionals can review and trust.

Joseph explains why OpenAI bundled financial data even when connectors already existed, what startups can build with the same plugin primitives, and why human taste and expert judgment are hard to measure. The conversation moves from analyst workflows and review chains to investment ideas and the problem of building useful financial evaluations.
